name: Distance from 52 Week High
description: The difference between the current stock price and the highest price that the stock has traded at in the past 52 weeks.

name: R&D Expenses
description: The amount of money a company spends on research and development to create new products or improve existing ones.

name: Half Year Performance
description: The performance of a company over the first six months of the fiscal year.

name: Distance from 52 Week Low
description: The difference between the current stock price and the lowest price that the stock has traded at in the past 52 weeks.

name: Cash
description: The amount of money a company has in its bank account or in short-term investments that can be used to pay off debts or invest in the business.

name: 1 Quarter Performance
description: The performance of a company over the previous three months.

name: 1 Day Performance
description: The change in stock price over the previous trading day.

name: Debt
description: The amount of money a company owes to creditors or lenders.

name: Revenue
description: The total amount of money a company earns from its business operations.

name: YTD Performance
description: The performance of a company since the beginning of the fiscal year.

name: 1 Year Performance
description: The performance of a company over the previous 12 months.

name: 3 Year Performance
description: The performance of a company over the previous 36 months

name: Gross Profit
description: The amount of money a company earns from its business operations after deducting the cost of goods sold.

name: 1 Month Performance
description: The performance of a company over the previous 30 days

name: Net Profit
description: The amount of money a company earns from its business operations after deducting all expenses.

name: 1 Week Performance
description: The performance of a company over the previous 7 days.

name: Market Cap
description: The total value of a company's outstanding shares of stock, calculated by multiplying the stock price by the number of shares outstanding.

name: Net Change in Cash
description: The difference between the amount of cash a company had at the beginning of a period and the amount it has at the end of the period.

name: Net Income
description: The amount of money a company earns from its business operations after deducting all expenses, including taxes.

name: Cash Ratio
description: A company's cash and short-term investments divided by its current liabilities, used to determine its ability to pay off short-term debts.

name: DCF vs Stock Price
description: A comparison of a company's estimated intrinsic value based on its cash flow projections versus its current stock price.

name: Inventory
description: The total value of a company's unsold goods and materials.

name: Dividend Yield
description: The annual dividend payment per share of stock divided by the stock price, expressed as a percentage.

name: Net Debt
description: The amount of a company's total debt minus its cash and short-term investments.

name: Asset Turnover TTM
description: A company's revenue divided by its total assets, used to measure how efficiently the company is using its assets to generate revenue over the past 12 months.

name: Gross Profit Margin
description: A company's gross profit divided by its revenue, expressed as a percentage, used to measure how much of each dollar of revenue is available to cover operating expenses and net profit.

name: Accounts Payable
description: The amount of money a company owes to its vendors or suppliers for goods and services received but not yet paid for.

name: Accounts Receivable
description: The amount of money a company is owed by its customers for goods and services sold but not yet paid for.

name: Cash & Short Term Investments
description: The total amount of cash and short-term investments a company has available that can be used to pay off debts or invest in the business.

name: Cost of Revenue
description: The total cost incurred by a company to produce and deliver goods or services, including the cost of raw materials, labor, and shipping.

name: Deferred Income Tax (mrq)
description: The amount of income tax a company has deferred or postponed paying to future periods, based on tax laws and regulations.

name: Effect of Forex Changes on Cash
description: The impact of changes in foreign currency exchange rates on a company's cash balance, which can affect its financial performance.

name: Enterprise Value Multiple (ttm)
description: The ratio of a company's enterprise value (the total value of its equity and debt) to its earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA), used to compare companies of different sizes and capital structures.

name: Free Cash Flow
description: The cash a company generates from its business operations after deducting capital expenditures (money spent on property, equipment, or other assets necessary to maintain or grow the business).

name: Goodwill & Intangible Assets
description: The value of intangible assets such as patents, trademarks, and brand names, as well as the excess of the purchase price over the fair value of net assets acquired in a business combination, known as goodwill.

name: Gross Profit
description: The amount of money a company earns from its business operations after deducting the cost of goods sold.

name: Income Tax Expense
description: The amount of money a company must pay in income taxes based on its taxable income.

name: Interest Expense
description: The cost of borrowing money from lenders or creditors, including interest payments on loans or bonds.

name: Long Term Debt
description: The amount of money a company owes to lenders or creditors that is due in more than one year.

name: Operating Cash Flow
description: The cash a company generates from its business operations, including revenue from sales and payments from customers, minus operating expenses such as wages, rent, and materials.

name: Operating Cycle (mrq)
description: The time it takes a company to convert its inventory into cash by selling goods and collecting payments from customers.

name: Operating Expenses
description: The expenses a company incurs in its daily operations, such as wages, rent, and materials.

name: Operating Income
description: The amount of money a company earns from its business operations after deducting operating expenses.

name: Retained Earnings
description: The portion of a company's net income that is reinvested in the business rather than distributed as dividends to shareholders.

name: Revenue (mrq)
description: The total amount of money a company earns from its business operations over the past quarter (three months).

name: Revenue per Employee
description: The amount of revenue generated by each employee of a company, calculated by dividing total revenue by the number of employees.

name: Employee Count
description: The total number of employees working for a company.

name: Selling & Marketing Expenses
description: The expenses a company incurs to promote and sell its products or services, such as advertising, sales commissions, and marketing campaigns.

name: Short Term Debt
description: The amount of money a company owes to lenders or creditors that is due in less than one year.

name: Total Assets
description: The total value of a company's assets, including both tangible assets (such as property, equipment, and inventory) and intangible assets (such as patents, trademarks, and brand names).

name: Total Liabilities
description: The total amount of money a company owes to creditors or lenders, including both short-term and long-term debt.

name: Total Non Current Assets
description: The total value of a company's long-term assets, such as property, equipment, and investments.

name: Total Stockholders Equity
description: The total value of a company's assets minus its liabilities, representing the amount of money that would be left over if all of the company's assets were sold and all of its debts were paid.
